actions.action: Run Health Check, capture baseline score
Fix every High-Risk Health Check finding inline
Verify Block Uninstalled Connected Apps enabled
actions.where: Setup -> OAuth and OpenID Connect Settings

actions.action: Block User-Agent and Username-Password OAuth flows
actions.where: Setup -> OAuth and OpenID Connect Settings

actions.action: Pull OAuth Usage; flag apps without business owner
actions.verify: Owner identified per app or scheduled for revoke

actions.action: Pull MAD/VAD holders
actions.soql: SELECT Assignee.Username FROM PermissionSetAssignment WHERE PermissionSet.PermissionsModifyAllData = true
actions.verify: List captured; cross-checked vs. expected admins

actions.action: Subscribe team to Salesforce Security Advisories
Verify MFA contractually enforced
actions.verify: Require MFA for all direct UI logins: ON

actions.action: Set admin profile session timeout to <= 2 hours
Lock sessions to IP for desktop clients
actions.verify: Lock sessions to IP address: ON

actions.action: Document the Day-1 baseline
actions.where: Save Health Check export, OAuth Usage CSV, MAD/VAD list to secure store

actions.action: FIDO2 / Security Key enrollment for every admin
actions.where: User -> Identity Verification -> Register Security Key

actions.action: Strip Modify All Data from non-admin Permission Sets
actions.verify: SOQL re-run shows only System Admin profile

actions.action: Strip View All Data from non-admin Permission Sets
Revoke Connected Apps without business owner
actions.where: Setup -> Connected Apps OAuth Usage -> Revoke
actions.verify: OAuth Usage shows only owned apps

actions.action: Lock Login IP for admin profile to corp egress
actions.where: Setup -> Profiles -> System Admin -> Login IP Ranges

actions.action: Disable Create Public Links for non-admin profiles
actions.verify: Create-link UI hidden for test user

actions.action: Audit existing Public Links
actions.soql: SELECT Id, Name, ExpiryDate, PreferencesPasswordRequired FROM ContentDistribution

actions.action: Force re-MFA on inactive admin accounts
Freeze users inactive > 90 days
actions.soql: SELECT Id, Username FROM User WHERE LastLoginDate < LAST_N_DAYS:90 AND IsActive = true

actions.action: Disable Connected App self-authorization
actions.where: Each Connected App -> Manage -> Edit Policies -> Permitted Users = Admin approved users are pre-authorized

actions.action: Sign-off: Week-1 attestation
Guest profile audit per Experience Cloud site (full Pillar 3 checklist)
First sharing-rules attestation (per object, criteria, justification, signoff)
Certificate inventory + ownership assignments + 30-day-before-expiry alerts
Consolidate or split to one integration user per integration
CSP Trusted Sites audit; remove unused entries
Remove Public Read/Write OWD on objects with PII or financial data
Custom Login Flow drafted for System Admin profile
Browser extension allowlist deployed via Chrome / Edge / Safari MDM
Setup Audit Trail + Login History nightly export
Real-Time Event Monitoring -> SIEM streaming
Top-5 Transaction Security policies deployed
Restore-test drill on a sample object from backup
IRP tabletop walkthrough with on-call team
Run Einstein Data Detect on free-text custom fields
Cert rotation runbook drafted; calendar alerts set
Integration-user lifecycle review
Sign-off: Month-1 attestation
OAuth Usage attestation -- new apps, anomalous user-counts, scope changes
Modify All Data / View All Data holder attestation
Guest profile diff vs. approved baseline (per Experience Cloud site)
Sharing rules diff vs. approved baseline (especially guest user sharing rules)
Connected Apps OAuth refresh-token rotation (90-day max)
Health Check score recorded; trend documented
Certificate expiration calendar reviewed; rotations scheduled
Permission Set Group migration progress (during 12-month structural lane)
Public-link audit (ContentDistribution SOQL)
Installed-package audit (every InstalledPackage reviewed)
Integration-user activity review
Restricted-data classification register reviewed
